brand.pitchDesc: Centralized platform for corporate authentication and identity management.

login.title: Sign in to your account
login.subtitle: Enter your credentials to access your account

register.title: Sign up
register.subtitle: Enter your personal details to create your access

resetPassword.title: Reset password
resetPassword.subtitle: Enter your registered username or email to receive reset instructions.

infoMessage.duplicateEmailsAllowed: Enter your username and we will send you instructions to reset your password.
infoMessage.default: Enter your username or email and we will send you instructions to reset your password.

updatePassword.title: Update password
updatePassword.subtitle: Set a secure new password for your account.

updateProfile.title: Complete your profile
updateProfile.subtitle: Please verify or update your basic account information to continue.

verifyEmail.title: Check your email
verifyEmail.desc: We sent a confirmation link to
verifyEmail.descEnd: Please open the link to activate your account.
verifyEmail.helpText: Check your spam or junk folder. If you still cannot find it, request a new link below.

configureTotp.title: Configure authenticator (OTP)
configureTotp.desc: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, or Authy) and enter the generated code.
configureTotp.qrHint: Open your app and scan this image
configureTotp.manualToggle: Can't scan the code? View manual key
configureTotp.manualHint: Enter this key directly into your authenticator app.

loginOtp.title: Authentication code
loginOtp.desc: Enter the 6-digit code shown in your authenticator app to verify your identity.

pageExpired.title: Session has expired
pageExpired.desc: For security reasons, your login session expired due to inactivity. You can restart the process to continue.
pageExpired.helpText: The temporary authentication session has expired.

requiredAction.successDesc: Your new password has been set successfully. You can now log in with your new credentials.
requiredAction.successHelpFallback: Your password has been updated successfully.
requiredAction.emailDesc: We have sent an email with the necessary instructions.
requiredAction.emailHelpFallback: Please check your inbox and follow the received link to continue.
requiredAction.actionDesc: You need to complete this action on your account to continue.
requiredAction.actionRedirectText: Redirecting you to the corresponding form...
requiredAction.infoDescFallback: Your request has been processed successfully.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.subtitle: Please review and accept the terms of use and policies for this laboratory environment to continue.
terms.acceptCheckbox: I have read and agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

idpReview.title: Review your Profile
idpReview.subtitle: You authenticated via an identity provider. Please confirm your details before continuing.
idpReview.bannerDesc: Data retrieved from your external identity provider

idpLinkConfirm.title: Link Existing Account
idpLinkConfirm.subtitle: An account already exists with your email address. Confirm to associate your external access.
idpLinkConfirm.noticeIntro: Your access will be linked to registered account:
idpLinkConfirm.noticeDetail: In future sign-ins, you can access using either your regular credentials or your external provider.

idpLinkEmail.title: Confirm Account Linking
idpLinkEmail.subtitle: An email has been sent to verify your identity and associate your external identity provider.
idpLinkEmail.helpText: Check your spam or junk folder. If you still cannot find it, you can request a new link.

selectAuthenticator.title: Choose an access method
selectAuthenticator.subtitle: You have multiple authentication factors configured. Select how you want to continue.
selectAuthenticator.passwordDesc: Sign in using your account password
selectAuthenticator.totpDesc: Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or TOTP code
selectAuthenticator.webauthnDesc: Windows Hello, fingerprint or physical USB key (FIDO2)

logoutConfirm.title: Do you want to log out?
logoutConfirm.subtitle: You are about to end your active session. You will need to sign in again to access.

webauthn.title: Register Security Key
webauthn.subtitle: Add a physical key (YubiKey), device biometrics (Windows Hello, Touch ID) or smartphone to sign in securely without passwords.
webauthn.boxDesc: Have your fingerprint sensor, Windows Hello PIN or USB security key ready before proceeding.
webauthn.errorUnsupported: Your browser or device does not support WebAuthn / FIDO2.

oauthGrant.title: Authorize Application
oauthGrant.subtitle: requests access to your user account
oauthGrant.alertNotice: You can revoke these permissions at any time from your account management console.

recoveryCodesConfig.title: 2FA Recovery Codes
recoveryCodesConfig.subtitle: Save these one-time backup codes in a safe place. You will need them if you lose your phone or security key.
recoveryCodesConfig.confirmCheck: I have safely backed up these recovery codes in a secure location.

recoveryCodeInput.title: Recovery Code
recoveryCodeInput.subtitle: Enter one of your emergency backup codes to verify your identity and log in.
recoveryCodeInput.label: Backup code

deleteAccountConfirm.title: Delete your account?
deleteAccountConfirm.warningDesc: Your credentials, active sessions and all personal data linked to your profile in dev will be permanently deleted.

deviceVerify.title: Link device
deviceVerify.subtitle: Enter the alphanumeric code displayed on your console, CLI or TV screen.
deviceVerify.label: Device link code

error.expiredTokenDesc: This link is no longer valid because it was already used or exceeded its validity period.
error.expiredTokenHelpText: Request a new reset link with your registered email.
error.sessionExpiredDesc: For security reasons, your login session expired due to inactivity. You can restart the process to continue.
error.sessionExpiredHelpText: The temporary authentication session has expired.
error.redirectDesc: Could not complete the flow because the return parameters are not authorized for this client.
error.generalDesc: An unexpected error occurred while processing the request.
